facts.summary: Phase 3 trial missed early stopping criteria at interim analysis, continues to full enrollment · Phase 3 · IV ganaxolone in refractory status epilepticus · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Trial did not meet pre-defined stopping criteria at the interim analysis; Marinus has completed RAISE enrollment at approximately 100 patients with topline results expected summer 2024
evidence.program_discontinued: Future development of IV ganaxolone in refractory status epilepticus to be assessed following review of the final RAISE results
